paired_measurements.limitations: Icon origins are in each image's screen coordinates; viewport origins are not identical and are recorded in the captures. Label dimensions were extracted from visible foreground pixels. No item selection, focus or hover state was paired.

api_boundary.gtk_icon_view_style_properties: GTK2 runtime inspection lists focus/cursor/link/selection-box/separator/tooltip colors and focus metrics; it does not list item-width, item-padding, column-spacing, row-spacing, margin or spacing as style properties.
api_boundary.gtk_icon_view_object_properties: The layout fields above are GtkIconView object properties normally supplied by the application.
api_boundary.consequence: Theme colors and focus/selection appearance can be translated through KDE roles. Exact grid pitch and padding need application-level values or remain a documented gap; a theme-only change cannot claim to align them.

next: Add a distinct GTK2 GtkIconView color/state adapter using current KDE roles and native tests for normal, backdrop, insensitive, selected and focus states. Keep application-owned layout metrics separate from theme recipes; measure/adjust them only through an explicitly scoped preview property set.
